subject: DataForge + Redwood joint integration roundtable — logistics & speakers
messages:
From: Elena Sokolov <elena.sokolov@dataforge.io>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: partnerships@dataforge.io
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint roundtable proposal: Vector search + inference integration

Hi Karthik,

Great speaking with Raj last week — thanks for the intro. DataForge runs a small partner webinar series in Q4 focusing on practical integrations (30–45 minute format + live Q&A). We’d love to do a joint roundtable with Redwood about integrating vector search pipelines with inference at scale.

High-level idea: a 35-minute panel + 10-minute live demo showing how DataForge vector indexing + Redwood Inference routing/caching improves end-to-end latency and cost for semantic search apps. Target audience: platform/infra leads at mid-market SaaS and startups.

Tentative dates: week of Oct 4–8. We can handle registration, landing page, and promotion if Redwood provides a speaker, a short deck, and logo.

If interested, I can send a one-page agenda and speaker checklist — would you prefer a Thursday or Tuesday slot that week?

Cheers,
Elena

Elena Sokolov
Head of Partnerships, DataForge
elena.sokolov@dataforge.io
